BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb)) <> 9
OR NOT (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb ?& ARRAY['schema', 'provider', 'kms_key_id', 'key_version', 'ciphertext_b64', 'nonce_b64', 'aad_sha256', 'mobile_hmac', 'contact_hmac'])
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'schema') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'schema' <> 'rsc.material_request_contact.v1'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'provider') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider' <> 'aliyun_kms'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'kms_key_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'kms_key_id' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_./:@+]{2,255}$'
OR lower(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'kms_key_id') LIKE ANY (
    ARRAY['%replace-with%', '%replace_me%', '%replace-me%',
          '%change-me%', '%changeme%']
)
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'key_version') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'key_version' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'ciphertext_b64') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$'
OR length(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') < 24
OR length(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') % 4 <> 0
OR octet_length(decode(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64', 'base64')) < 17
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'nonce_b64') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'nonce_b64' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{16}$'
OR octet_length(decode(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'nonce_b64', 'base64')) <> 12
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'aad_sha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'aad_sha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'aad_sha256' <> encode(sha256(convert_to('cloud_oam.material_request.contact.envelope.v1', 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('request_id=' || (NEW.id)::text, 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('requester_person_id=' || (NEW.requester_person_id)::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'mobile_hmac') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'mobile_hmac' !~ '^hmac:[1-9][0-9]{0,9}:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'contact_hmac') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'contact_hmac' !~ '^hmac:[1-9][0-9]{0,9}:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
       OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.address_masked_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.address_masked_jsonb)) <> 5
OR NOT (NEW.address_masked_jsonb ?& ARRAY[
    'province_code', 'province_name', 'city_name', 'district_name', 'detail_masked'
])
OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(NEW.address_masked_jsonb) AS item
     WHERE jsonb_typeof(item.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
       OR btrim(item.value #>> '{}') = ''
       OR item.value #>> '{}' <> btrim(item.value #>> '{}')
)
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'province_code') > 12
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'province_name') > 80
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'city_name') > 80
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'district_name') > 80
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'detail_masked') > 500
OR NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'detail_masked' !~ '[*＊•]'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb)) <> 2
OR NOT (NEW.contact_masked_jsonb ?& ARRAY['name_masked', 'mobile_masked'])
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->'name_masked') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->'mobile_masked') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked' <> btrim(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked')
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked' <> btrim(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked')
OR length(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 120
OR length(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked' !~ '[*＊•]'
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked' !~ '[*＊•]'
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked' ~ '[0-9]{7}' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        IF NEW.allocation_status <> 'not_allocated'
           OR NEW.reservation_status <> 'not_reserved'
           OR NEW.outbound_status <> 'not_started'
           OR NEW.shipment_status <> 'not_started'
           OR NEW.logistics_signature_status <> 'not_signed'
           OR NEW.oam_receipt_status <> 'not_occurred'
           OR NEW.personal_inbound_status <> 'not_started'
           OR NEW.notification_status <> 'not_started'
           OR NEW.reconciliation_status <> 'not_started' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
       OR NEW.request_no IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_no
       OR NEW.requester_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requester_user_id
       OR NEW.requester_person_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requester_person_id
       OR NEW.requester_org_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requester_org_id
       OR NEW.created_by_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by_user_id
       OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
       OR (OLD.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
           AND NEW.submitted_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.submitted_at)
       OR (OLD.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
           AND NEW.approval_mode IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approval_mode) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.revision_no IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.revision_no THEN
        IF OLD.status <> 'returned'
           OR NEW.status <> 'returned'
           OR NEW.revision_no <> OLD.revision_no + 1
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM public.material_request_revisions AS revision
                WHERE revision.request_id = NEW.id
                  AND revision.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
                  AND revision.status = 'draft'
                  AND revision.work_order_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.work_order_id
                  AND revision.purpose = NEW.purpose
                  AND revision.urgency = NEW.urgency
                  AND revision.expected_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.expected_date
                  AND revision.address_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.address_snapshot_jsonb
                  AND revision.address_masked_jsonb = NEW.address_masked_jsonb
                  AND revision.contact_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb
                  AND revision.contact_masked_jsonb = NEW.contact_masked_jsonb
                  AND revision.note = NEW.note
                  AND revision.approval_mode = NEW.approval_mode
           ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.work_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.work_order_id
       OR NEW.purpose IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.purpose
       OR NEW.urgency IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.urgency
       OR NEW.expected_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.expected_date
       OR NEW.address_snapshot_jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.address_snapshot_jsonb
       OR NEW.address_masked_jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.address_masked_jsonb
       OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contact_snapshot_jsonb
       OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contact_masked_jsonb
       OR NEW.note IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.note THEN
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
              FROM public.material_request_revisions AS revision
             WHERE revision.request_id = NEW.id
               AND revision.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
               AND revision.status = 'draft'
               AND revision.work_order_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.work_order_id
               AND revision.purpose = NEW.purpose
               AND revision.urgency = NEW.urgency
               AND revision.expected_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.expected_date
               AND revision.address_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.address_snapshot_jsonb
               AND revision.address_masked_jsonb = NEW.address_masked_jsonb
               AND revision.contact_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb
               AND revision.contact_masked_jsonb = NEW.contact_masked_jsonb
               AND revision.note = NEW.note
               AND revision.approval_mode = NEW.approval_mode
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF OLD.status IN ('draft', 'returned')
       AND NEW.status IN ('submitted', 'approval_in_progress')
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_revisions AS revision
            WHERE revision.request_id = NEW.id
              AND revision.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
              AND revision.status = 'sealed'
       ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.outbound_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.outbound_status THEN
        IF OLD.outbound_status NOT IN ('not_started', 'pending_pick', 'picked')
           OR NEW.outbound_status NOT IN ('pending_pick', 'picked', 'outbound')
           OR NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NEW.allocation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.allocation_status
           OR NEW.reservation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_status
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_commands c
                WHERE c.request_id = NEW.id AND c.target_version = NEW.version AND c.operation IN ('pick', 'outbound')
                  AND c.result_jsonb->'state_axes'->>'outbound_status' = NEW.outbound_status)
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated'; END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.personal_inbound_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.personal_inbound_status THEN
        IF NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NEW.personal_inbound_status IS DISTINCT FROM (WITH line_totals AS (
        SELECT line.id, line.final_approved_qty - line.cancelled_qty AS net,
            COALESCE((SELECT sum(receipt_line.accepted_qty)
                FROM public.receipt_lines receipt_line
                JOIN public.receipts receipt ON receipt.id = receipt_line.receipt_id
                JOIN public.shipment_lines shipped ON shipped.id = receipt_line.shipment_line_id
                JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = shipped.outbound_posting_id
                WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND outbound.request_line_id = line.id
                  AND receipt.status IN ('accepted', 'exception')), 0) AS accepted,
            COALESCE((SELECT sum(receipt_line.accepted_qty)
                FROM public.receipt_lines receipt_line
                JOIN public.receipts receipt ON receipt.id = receipt_line.receipt_id
                JOIN public.shipment_lines shipped ON shipped.id = receipt_line.shipment_line_id
                JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = shipped.outbound_posting_id
                WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND outbound.request_line_id = line.id
                  AND receipt.status IN ('accepted', 'exception') AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM public.inbound_orders inbound
                    JOIN public.inbound_postings posting ON posting.inbound_order_id = inbound.id
                    JOIN public.inventory_transactions tx ON tx.id = posting.inventory_transaction_id
                    WHERE inbound.receipt_id = receipt_line.receipt_id
                      AND tx.status = 'posted' AND tx.movement_type = 'transfer'
                      AND tx.source_document_type = 'personal_inbound'
                      AND replace(CAST(inbound.id AS text), '-', '') = replace(tx.source_document_id, '-', '')
                )), 0) AS posted,
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.shipment_lines shipped
                JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = shipped.outbound_posting_id
                WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND outbound.request_line_id = line.id
                  AND shipped.shipped_qty > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS shipped
        FROM public.material_request_lines line
        WHERE line.request_id = NEW.id AND line.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
          AND line.final_approved_qty > line.cancelled_qty
    ) SELECT CASE
        WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'not_started'
        WHEN sum(CASE WHEN posted >= net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = count(*) THEN 'posted'
        WHEN sum(CASE WHEN accepted >= net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = count(*) THEN 'accepted'
        WHEN sum(CASE WHEN accepted > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'partially_accepted'
        WHEN sum(shipped) > 0 THEN 'pending_acceptance'
        ELSE 'not_started' END FROM line_totals) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION '0084 personal inbound projection does not match fulfillment facts' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.shipment_status IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.shipments shipment
        JOIN public.material_request_commands command
          ON command.idempotency_key_hash = shipment.idempotency_key_hash
        JOIN public.shipment_lines line ON line.shipment_id = shipment.id
        JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = line.outbound_posting_id
        WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND line.shipped_qty > 0
          AND shipment.status = 'shipped' AND command.operation = 'shipment'
          AND command.request_id = NEW.id AND command.target_version <= NEW.version
          AND command.request_hash = shipment.request_hash
          AND command.occurred_at = shipment.created_at 
    ) THEN 'shipped' ELSE 'not_started' END)
       OR (NEW.shipment_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.shipment_status AND (
           NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.shipments shipment
        JOIN public.material_request_commands command
          ON command.idempotency_key_hash = shipment.idempotency_key_hash
        JOIN public.shipment_lines line ON line.shipment_id = shipment.id
        JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = line.outbound_posting_id
        WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND line.shipped_qty > 0
          AND shipment.status = 'shipped' AND command.operation = 'shipment'
          AND command.request_id = NEW.id AND command.target_version = NEW.version
          AND command.request_hash = shipment.request_hash
          AND command.occurred_at = shipment.created_at AND command.occurred_at = NEW.updated_at
    ))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '0168 shipment projection does not match handover command' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.logistics_signature_status <> 'not_signed'
       OR NEW.oam_receipt_status <> 'not_occurred'
       OR NEW.notification_status <> 'not_started'
       OR NEW.reconciliation_status <> 'not_started' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.allocation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.allocation_status
       AND NEW.reservation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_status THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.allocation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.allocation_status THEN
        IF OLD.allocation_status NOT IN ('not_allocated', 'partially_allocated')
           OR NEW.allocation_status NOT IN ('partially_allocated', 'allocated')
           OR NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1
           OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM public.stock_allocations AS allocation
                 JOIN public.material_request_commands AS command
                   ON command.request_id = allocation.request_id
                  AND command.operation = 'allocate'
                  AND command.target_version = NEW.version
                WHERE allocation.request_id = NEW.id
                  AND allocation.request_version = NEW.version
                  AND allocation.status = 'allocated'
                  AND command.request_jsonb->>'request_id' = NEW.id::text
                  AND command.request_jsonb->>'target_version' = NEW.version::text
           ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.reservation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_status THEN
        IF OLD.reservation_status NOT IN ('not_reserved', 'pending', 'reserved', 'partially_released', 'released')
           OR NEW.reservation_status NOT IN ('pending', 'reserved', 'partially_released', 'released')
           OR NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_commands c
                WHERE c.request_id = NEW.id AND c.target_version = NEW.version
                  AND c.operation IN ('reserve', 'release')
                  AND c.result_jsonb->'state_axes'->>'reservation_status' = NEW.reservation_status
           ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated'; END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END

              JOIN public.oam_sync_scope_bindings AS read_work_order
                ON read_work_order.source_system = write_work_order.source_system
               AND read_work_order.source_instance = write_work_order.source_instance
               AND read_work_order.scope_key = write_work_order.scope_key
               AND read_work_order.company_id = write_work_order.company_id
               AND read_work_order.org_code = write_work_order.org_code
               AND read_work_order.enabled
               AND read_work_order.principal_name = write_work_order.principal_name
               AND read_work_order.capability = 'projector_read'
               AND read_work_order.entity_type = 'work_order'
              JOIN public.oam_sync_scope_bindings AS read_employee
                ON read_employee.source_system = write_work_order.source_system
               AND read_employee.source_instance = write_work_order.source_instance
               AND read_employee.scope_key = write_work_order.scope_key
               AND read_employee.company_id = write_work_order.company_id
               AND read_employee.org_code = write_work_order.org_code
               AND read_employee.enabled
               AND read_employee.principal_name = write_work_order.principal_name
               AND read_employee.capability = 'projector_read'
               AND read_employee.entity_type = 'employee'
              JOIN public.source_systems AS source
                ON source.code = write_work_order.source_system
               AND source.mode = 'read_only'
               AND source.enabled
               AND source.configuration_jsonb = pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                   'projection_schema', 'rsc.oam_work_order_projection.v1',
                   'edge_source_instance', write_work_order.source_instance,
                   'work_order_company_id', write_work_order.company_id,
                   'work_order_org_code', write_work_order.org_code,
                   'work_order_scope_key', write_work_order.scope_key
               )
             WHERE write_work_order.enabled
               AND write_work_order.principal_name = session_user::text
               AND write_work_order.capability = 'projector_write'
               AND write_work_order.entity_type = 'work_order'
        ) AND (
            SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) = 3
              FROM public.oam_sync_scope_bindings AS binding
             WHERE binding.enabled
               AND binding.principal_name = session_user::text
        )
        ELSE false
    END

rsc_guard_material_request_identity_0029.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rsc_guard_material_request_identity_0029()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb)) <> 9
OR NOT (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb ?& ARRAY['schema', 'provider', 'kms_key_id', 'key_version', 'ciphertext_b64', 'nonce_b64', 'aad_sha256', 'mobile_hmac', 'contact_hmac'])
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'schema') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'schema' <> 'rsc.material_request_contact.v1'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'provider') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider' <> 'aliyun_kms'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'kms_key_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'kms_key_id' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_./:@+]{2,255}$'
OR lower(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'kms_key_id') LIKE ANY (
    ARRAY['%replace-with%', '%replace_me%', '%replace-me%',
          '%change-me%', '%changeme%']
)
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'key_version') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'key_version' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'ciphertext_b64') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$'
OR length(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') < 24
OR length(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') % 4 <> 0

               AND revision.address_masked_jsonb = NEW.address_masked_jsonb
               AND revision.contact_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb
               AND revision.contact_masked_jsonb = NEW.contact_masked_jsonb
               AND revision.note = NEW.note
               AND revision.approval_mode = NEW.approval_mode
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF OLD.status IN ('draft', 'returned')
       AND NEW.status IN ('submitted', 'approval_in_progress')
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_revisions AS revision
            WHERE revision.request_id = NEW.id
              AND revision.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
              AND revision.status = 'sealed'
       ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.outbound_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.outbound_status THEN
        IF OLD.outbound_status NOT IN ('not_started', 'pending_pick', 'picked')
           OR NEW.outbound_status NOT IN ('pending_pick', 'picked', 'outbound')
           OR NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NEW.allocation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.allocation_status
           OR NEW.reservation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_status
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_commands c
                WHERE c.request_id = NEW.id AND c.target_version = NEW.version AND c.operation IN ('pick', 'outbound')
                  AND c.result_jsonb->'state_axes'->>'outbound_status' = NEW.outbound_status)
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated'; END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.personal_inbound_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.personal_inbound_status THEN
        IF NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NEW.personal_inbound_status IS DISTINCT FROM (WITH line_totals AS (
        SELECT line.id, line.final_approved_qty - line.cancelled_qty AS net,
            COALESCE((SELECT sum(receipt_line.accepted_qty)
                FROM public.receipt_lines receipt_line
                JOIN public.receipts receipt ON receipt.id = receipt_line.receipt_id
                JOIN public.shipment_lines shipped ON shipped.id = receipt_line.shipment_line_id
                JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = shipped.outbound_posting_id
                WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND outbound.request_line_id = line.id
                  AND receipt.status IN ('accepted', 'exception')), 0) AS accepted,
            COALESCE((SELECT sum(receipt_line.accepted_qty)
                FROM public.receipt_lines receipt_line
                JOIN public.receipts receipt ON receipt.id = receipt_line.receipt_id
                JOIN public.shipment_lines shipped ON shipped.id = receipt_line.shipment_line_id
                JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = shipped.outbound_posting_id
                WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND outbound.request_line_id = line.id
                  AND receipt.status IN ('accepted', 'exception') AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM public.inbound_orders inbound
                    JOIN public.inbound_postings posting ON posting.inbound_order_id = inbound.id
                    JOIN public.inventory_transactions tx ON tx.id = posting.inventory_transaction_id
                    WHERE inbound.receipt_id = receipt_line.receipt_id
                      AND tx.status = 'posted' AND tx.movement_type = 'transfer'
                      AND tx.source_document_type = 'personal_inbound'
                      AND replace(CAST(inbound.id AS text), '-', '') = replace(tx.source_document_id, '-', '')
                )), 0) AS posted,
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.shipment_lines shipped
                JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = shipped.outbound_posting_id
                WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND outbound.request_line_id = line.id
                  AND shipped.shipped_qty > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS shipped
        FROM public.material_request_lines line
        WHERE line.request_id = NEW.id AND line.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
          AND line.final_approved_qty > line.cancelled_qty
    ) SELECT CASE
        WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'not_started'
        WHEN sum(CASE WHEN posted >= net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = count(*) THEN 'posted'
        WHEN sum(CASE WHEN accepted >= net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = count(*) THEN 'accepted'
        WHEN sum(CASE WHEN accepted > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'partially_accepted'
        WHEN sum(shipped) > 0 THEN 'pending_acceptance'
        ELSE 'not_started' END FROM line_totals) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION '0084 personal inbound projection does not match fulfillment facts' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.shipment_status IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.shipments shipment
        JOIN public.material_request_commands command
          ON command.idempotency_key_hash = shipment.idempotency_key_hash
        JOIN public.shipment_lines line ON line.shipment_id = shipment.id
        JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = line.outbound_posting_id
        WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND line.shipped_qty > 0
          AND shipment.status = 'shipped' AND command.operation = 'shipment'
          AND command.request_id = NEW.id AND command.target_version <= NEW.version
          AND command.request_hash = shipment.request_hash
          AND command.occurred_at = shipment.created_at 
    ) THEN 'shipped' ELSE 'not_started' END)
       OR (NEW.shipment_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.shipment_status AND (
           NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.shipments shipment
        JOIN public.material_request_commands command
          ON command.idempotency_key_hash = shipment.idempotency_key_hash
        JOIN public.shipment_lines line ON line.shipment_id = shipment.id
        JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = line.outbound_posting_id
        WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND line.shipped_qty > 0
          AND shipment.status = 'shipped' AND command.operation = 'shipment'
          AND command.request_id = NEW.id AND command.target_version = NEW.version
          AND command.request_hash = shipment.request_hash
          AND command.occurred_at = shipment.created_at AND command.occurred_at = NEW.updated_at
    ))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '0168 shipment projection does not match handover command' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.logistics_signature_status <> 'not_signed'
       OR NEW.oam_receipt_status <> 'not_occurred'
       OR NEW.notification_status <> 'not_started'
       OR NEW.reconciliation_status <> 'not_started' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.allocation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.allocation_status
       AND NEW.reservation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_status THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.allocation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.allocation_status THEN
        IF OLD.allocation_status NOT IN ('not_allocated', 'partially_allocated')
           OR NEW.allocation_status NOT IN ('partially_allocated', 'allocated')
           OR NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1
           OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM public.stock_allocations AS allocation
                 JOIN public.material_request_commands AS command
                   ON command.request_id = allocation.request_id
                  AND command.operation = 'allocate'
                  AND command.target_version = NEW.version
                WHERE allocation.request_id = NEW.id
                  AND allocation.request_version = NEW.version
                  AND allocation.status = 'allocated'
                  AND command.request_jsonb->>'request_id' = NEW.id::text
                  AND command.request_jsonb->>'target_version' = NEW.version::text
           ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.reservation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_status THEN
        IF OLD.reservation_status NOT IN ('not_reserved', 'pending', 'reserved', 'partially_released', 'released')
           OR NEW.reservation_status NOT IN ('pending', 'reserved', 'partially_released', 'released')
           OR NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_commands c
                WHERE c.request_id = NEW.id AND c.target_version = NEW.version
                  AND c.operation IN ('reserve', 'release')
                  AND c.result_jsonb->'state_axes'->>'reservation_status' = NEW.reservation_status
           ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated'; END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rsc_guard_material_request_revision_0029()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    requester_person uuid;
    current_revision_no integer;
    request_status text;
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    SELECT request.requester_person_id, request.revision_no, request.status
      INTO requester_person, current_revision_no, request_status
      FROM public.material_requests AS request
     WHERE request.id = NEW.request_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb)) <> 9
OR NOT (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb ?& ARRAY['schema', 'provider', 'kms_key_id', 'key_version', 'ciphertext_b64', 'nonce_b64', 'aad_sha256', 'mobile_hmac', 'contact_hmac'])
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'schema') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'schema' <> 'rsc.material_request_contact.v1'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'provider') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider' <> 'aliyun_kms'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'kms_key_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'kms_key_id' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_./:@+]{2,255}$'
OR lower(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'kms_key_id') LIKE ANY (
    ARRAY['%replace-with%', '%replace_me%', '%replace-me%',
          '%change-me%', '%changeme%']
)
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'key_version') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'key_version' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'ciphertext_b64') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$'
OR length(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') < 24
OR length(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') % 4 <> 0
OR octet_length(decode(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64', 'base64')) < 17
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'nonce_b64') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'nonce_b64' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{16}$'
OR octet_length(decode(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'nonce_b64', 'base64')) <> 12
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'aad_sha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'aad_sha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'aad_sha256' <> encode(sha256(convert_to('cloud_oam.material_request.contact.envelope.v1', 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('request_id=' || (NEW.request_id)::text, 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('requester_person_id=' || (requester_person)::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'mobile_hmac') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'mobile_hmac' !~ '^hmac:[1-9][0-9]{0,9}:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'contact_hmac') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'contact_hmac' !~ '^hmac:[1-9][0-9]{0,9}:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
       OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.address_masked_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.address_masked_jsonb)) <> 5
OR NOT (NEW.address_masked_jsonb ?& ARRAY[
    'province_code', 'province_name', 'city_name', 'district_name', 'detail_masked'
])
OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(NEW.address_masked_jsonb) AS item
     WHERE jsonb_typeof(item.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
       OR btrim(item.value #>> '{}') = ''
       OR item.value #>> '{}' <> btrim(item.value #>> '{}')
)
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'province_code') > 12
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'province_name') > 80
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'city_name') > 80
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'district_name') > 80
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'detail_masked') > 500
OR NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'detail_masked' !~ '[*＊•]'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb)) <> 2
OR NOT (NEW.contact_masked_jsonb ?& ARRAY['name_masked', 'mobile_masked'])
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->'name_masked') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->'mobile_masked') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked' <> btrim(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked')
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked' <> btrim(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked')
OR length(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 120
OR length(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked' !~ '[*＊•]'
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked' !~ '[*＊•]'
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked' ~ '[0-9]{7}' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        IF NEW.status <> 'draft'
           OR (NEW.revision_no = 1 AND (
               NEW.previous_revision_id IS NOT NULL
               OR current_revision_no <> 1
               OR request_status <> 'draft'
               OR EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_revisions AS existing
                    WHERE existing.request_id = NEW.request_id
               )
           ))
           OR (NEW.revision_no > 1 AND (
               NEW.revision_no <> current_revision_no + 1
               OR request_status <> 'returned'
               OR NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM public.material_request_revisions AS previous
                     JOIN public.approval_instances AS instance
                       ON instance.request_revision_id = previous.id
                    WHERE previous.id = NEW.previous_revision_id
                      AND previous.request_id = NEW.request_id
                      AND previous.revision_no = NEW.revision_no - 1
                      AND previous.status = 'sealed'
                      AND instance.status IN ('returned', 'superseded')
               )
           )) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
       OR NEW.request_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_id
       OR NEW.revision_no IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.revision_no
       OR NEW.previous_revision_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.previous_revision_id
       OR NEW.created_by_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by_user_id
       OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
       OR OLD.status = 'sealed'
       OR NEW.status NOT IN ('draft', 'sealed')
       OR current_revision_no <> NEW.revision_no
       OR request_status NOT IN ('draft', 'returned', 'approval_in_progress') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.status = 'sealed' THEN
        IF NEW.content_manifest_sha256 !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
           OR NEW.sealed_at IS NULL
           OR NEW.sealed_by_user_id IS NULL
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_lines AS line
                WHERE line.revision_id = NEW.id
                  AND line.request_id = NEW.request_id
                  AND line.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
           )
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM public.material_requests AS request
                WHERE request.id = NEW.request_id
                  AND request.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
                  AND request.work_order_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.work_order_id
                  AND request.purpose = NEW.purpose
                  AND request.urgency = NEW.urgency
                  AND request.expected_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.expected_date
                  AND request.address_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.address_snapshot_jsonb
                  AND request.address_masked_jsonb = NEW.address_masked_jsonb
                  AND request.contact_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb
                  AND request.contact_masked_jsonb = NEW.contact_masked_jsonb
                  AND request.note = NEW.note
                  AND request.approval_mode = NEW.approval_mode
           ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
    ELSIF NEW.content_manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.sealed_at IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.sealed_by_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END

       OR NEW.previous_revision_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.previous_revision_id
       OR NEW.created_by_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by_user_id
       OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
       OR OLD.status = 'sealed'
       OR NEW.status NOT IN ('draft', 'sealed')
       OR current_revision_no <> NEW.revision_no
       OR request_status NOT IN ('draft', 'returned', 'approval_in_progress') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.status = 'sealed' THEN
        IF NEW.content_manifest_sha256 !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
           OR NEW.sealed_at IS NULL
           OR NEW.sealed_by_user_id IS NULL
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_lines AS line
                WHERE line.revision_id = NEW.id
                  AND line.request_id = NEW.request_id
                  AND line.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
           )
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM public.material_requests AS request
                WHERE request.id = NEW.request_id
                  AND request.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
                  AND request.work_order_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.work_order_id
                  AND request.purpose = NEW.purpose
                  AND request.urgency = NEW.urgency
                  AND request.expected_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.expected_date
                  AND request.address_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.address_snapshot_jsonb
                  AND request.address_masked_jsonb = NEW.address_masked_jsonb
                  AND request.contact_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb
                  AND request.contact_masked_jsonb = NEW.contact_masked_jsonb
                  AND request.note = NEW.note
                  AND request.approval_mode = NEW.approval_mode
           ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
    ELSIF NEW.content_manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.sealed_at IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.sealed_by_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END

rsc_claim_application_key_version_0180().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rsc_claim_application_key_version_0180()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE provider_name text;
BEGIN
    IF current_user <> 'star_oam_migrator' OR session_user <> 'star_oam_migrator'
       OR TG_TABLE_SCHEMA <> 'public'
       OR TG_TABLE_NAME NOT IN ('kms_data_key_pins', 'openbao_data_key_pins')
       OR TG_OP <> 'INSERT' OR TG_WHEN <> 'AFTER' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501',
            MESSAGE = 'Direct migrator key-pin insertion required';
    END IF;
    provider_name := CASE TG_TABLE_NAME WHEN 'kms_data_key_pins'
        THEN 'aliyun_kms' ELSE 'openbao_transit_v1' END;
    -- The immediate shared primary key arbitrates concurrent providers.
    -- An ordinary INSERT is intentional: never ignore a conflicting claim.
    INSERT INTO public.application_key_version_claims
        (purpose, application_key_version, provider, ciphertext_sha256, created_at)
    VALUES (NEW.purpose, NEW.application_key_version, provider_name,
        NEW.ciphertext_sha256, NEW.created_at);
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rsc_guard_application_key_version_claim_0180()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF current_user <> 'star_oam_migrator' OR session_user <> 'star_oam_migrator'
       OR TG_TABLE_SCHEMA <> 'public' OR TG_TABLE_NAME <> 'application_key_version_claims'
       OR TG_OP <> 'INSERT' OR TG_WHEN <> 'BEFORE' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501',
            MESSAGE = 'Direct migrator key-claim insertion required';
    END IF;
    IF NOT (
        (NEW.provider = 'aliyun_kms' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.kms_data_key_pins p
             WHERE p.purpose = NEW.purpose
               AND p.application_key_version = NEW.application_key_version
               AND p.ciphertext_sha256 = NEW.ciphertext_sha256
               AND p.created_at = NEW.created_at))
        OR (NEW.provider = 'openbao_transit_v1' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.openbao_data_key_pins p
             WHERE p.purpose = NEW.purpose
               AND p.application_key_version = NEW.application_key_version
               AND p.ciphertext_sha256 = NEW.ciphertext_sha256
               AND p.created_at = NEW.created_at))
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
            MESSAGE = 'Application key claim requires its exact existing pin';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END

rsc_guard_material_request_identity_0029.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rsc_guard_material_request_identity_0029()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF (CASE WHEN NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'schema' = 'rsc.material_request_contact.v1' AND NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider' = 'aliyun_kms' THEN (jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb)) <> 9
OR NOT (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb ?& ARRAY['schema', 'provider', 'kms_key_id', 'key_version', 'ciphertext_b64', 'nonce_b64', 'aad_sha256', 'mobile_hmac', 'contact_hmac'])
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'schema') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'schema' <> 'rsc.material_request_contact.v1'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'provider') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider' <> 'aliyun_kms'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'kms_key_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'kms_key_id' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_./:@+]{2,255}$'
OR lower(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'kms_key_id') LIKE ANY (
    ARRAY['%replace-with%', '%replace_me%', '%replace-me%',
          '%change-me%', '%changeme%']
)
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'key_version') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'key_version' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'ciphertext_b64') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$'
OR length(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') < 24
OR length(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') % 4 <> 0
OR octet_length(decode(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64', 'base64')) < 17
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'nonce_b64') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'nonce_b64' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{16}$'
OR octet_length(decode(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'nonce_b64', 'base64')) <> 12
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'aad_sha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'aad_sha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'aad_sha256' <> encode(sha256(convert_to('cloud_oam.material_request.contact.envelope.v1', 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('request_id=' || (NEW.id)::text, 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('requester_person_id=' || (NEW.requester_person_id)::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'mobile_hmac') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'mobile_hmac' !~ '^hmac:[1-9][0-9]{0,9}:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'contact_hmac') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'contact_hmac' !~ '^hmac:[1-9][0-9]{0,9}:[0-9a-f]{64}$')
WHEN NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'schema' = 'rsc.material_request_contact.v2' AND NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider' = 'openbao_transit_v1' THEN COALESCE((jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb) = 'object' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb)) ELSE -1 END) <> 13
OR NOT (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb ?& ARRAY['schema', 'provider', 'purpose', 'environment', 'provider_instance_id', 'key_path', 'application_key_version', 'transit_key_version', 'ciphertext_b64', 'nonce_b64', 'aad_sha256', 'mobile_hmac', 'contact_hmac'])
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'schema') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'provider') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'purpose') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'environment') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'provider_instance_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'key_path') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'ciphertext_b64') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'nonce_b64') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'aad_sha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'mobile_hmac') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'contact_hmac') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'schema') <> 'rsc.material_request_contact.v2'
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider') <> 'openbao_transit_v1'
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'purpose') <> 'material_request_contact'
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'key_path') <> 'transit/keys/rsc-material-request-contact'
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'environment') NOT IN ('development', 'test', 'staging', 'production')
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider_instance_id') !~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,62}$'
OR COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'application_key_version') = 'number' AND (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'application_key_version') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$' THEN (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'application_key_version')::bigint END) BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647, false) IS NOT TRUE
OR COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'transit_key_version') = 'number' AND (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'transit_key_version') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$' THEN (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'transit_key_version')::bigint END) BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647, false) IS NOT TRUE
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$'
OR length((NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64')) < 24 OR length((NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64')) % 4 <> 0
OR octet_length((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'ciphertext_b64') = 'string' AND (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$' AND length((NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64')) % 4 = 0 THEN decode((NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64'), 'base64') END)) < 17
OR replace(encode((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'ciphertext_b64') = 'string' AND (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$' AND length((NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64')) % 4 = 0 THEN decode((NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64'), 'base64') END), 'base64'), E'\n', '') IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'ciphertext_b64')
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'nonce_b64') !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{16}$'
OR octet_length((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->'nonce_b64') = 'string' AND (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'nonce_b64') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{16}$' THEN decode((NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'nonce_b64'), 'base64') END)) <> 12
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'aad_sha256') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
OR NEW.id IS NULL OR NEW.requester_person_id IS NULL
OR NEW.id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid
OR NEW.requester_person_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'aad_sha256') IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to('cloud_oam.material_request.contact.envelope.v2', 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('provider=' || (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider'), 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('purpose=' || (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'purpose'), 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('environment=' || (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'environment'), 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('provider_instance_id=' || (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider_instance_id'), 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('key_path=' || (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'key_path'), 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('application_key_version=' || (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'application_key_version'), 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('transit_key_version=' || (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'transit_key_version'), 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('request_id=' || (NEW.id)::text, 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') || convert_to('requester_person_id=' || (NEW.requester_person_id)::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'mobile_hmac') !~ '^hmac:[1-9][0-9]{0,9}:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
OR (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'contact_hmac') !~ '^hmac:[1-9][0-9]{0,9}:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.openbao_data_key_pins AS contact_pin
JOIN public.application_key_version_claims AS contact_claim
  ON contact_claim.purpose = contact_pin.purpose
 AND contact_claim.application_key_version = contact_pin.application_key_version
 AND contact_claim.provider = 'openbao_transit_v1'
 AND contact_claim.ciphertext_sha256 = contact_pin.ciphertext_sha256
 AND contact_claim.created_at = contact_pin.created_at
WHERE contact_pin.purpose = 'material_request_contact'
  AND contact_pin.environment = (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'environment')
  AND contact_pin.provider_instance_id = (NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb->>'provider_instance_id')
  AND contact_pin.key_path = 'transit/keys/rsc-material-request-contact'

       OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.address_masked_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'

OR NOT (NEW.address_masked_jsonb ?& ARRAY[

])
OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(NEW.address_masked_jsonb) AS item
     WHERE jsonb_typeof(item.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'

OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'province_code') > 12
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'province_name') > 80
OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'city_name') > 80

OR length(NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'detail_masked') > 500
OR NEW.address_masked_jsonb->>'detail_masked' !~ '[*＊•]'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb)) <> 2
OR NOT (NEW.contact_masked_jsonb ?& ARRAY['name_masked', 'mobile_masked'])
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->'name_masked') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->'mobile_masked') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked' <> btrim(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked')
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked' <> btrim(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked')
OR length(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 120
OR length(NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'name_masked' !~ '[*＊•]'
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked' !~ '[*＊•]'
OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb->>'mobile_masked' ~ '[0-9]{7}' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;

           OR NEW.reservation_status <> 'not_reserved'
           OR NEW.outbound_status <> 'not_started'
           OR NEW.shipment_status <> 'not_started'
           OR NEW.logistics_signature_status <> 'not_signed'
           OR NEW.oam_receipt_status <> 'not_occurred'
           OR NEW.personal_inbound_status <> 'not_started'
           OR NEW.notification_status <> 'not_started'
           OR NEW.reconciliation_status <> 'not_started' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
       OR NEW.request_no IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_no
       OR NEW.requester_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requester_user_id
       OR NEW.requester_person_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requester_person_id
       OR NEW.requester_org_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requester_org_id
       OR NEW.created_by_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by_user_id
       OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
       OR (OLD.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
           AND NEW.submitted_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.submitted_at)
       OR (OLD.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
           AND NEW.approval_mode IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approval_mode) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.revision_no IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.revision_no THEN
        IF OLD.status <> 'returned'
           OR NEW.status <> 'returned'
           OR NEW.revision_no <> OLD.revision_no + 1
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM public.material_request_revisions AS revision
                WHERE revision.request_id = NEW.id
                  AND revision.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
                  AND revision.status = 'draft'
                  AND revision.work_order_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.work_order_id
                  AND revision.purpose = NEW.purpose
                  AND revision.urgency = NEW.urgency
                  AND revision.expected_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.expected_date
                  AND revision.address_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.address_snapshot_jsonb
                  AND revision.address_masked_jsonb = NEW.address_masked_jsonb
                  AND revision.contact_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb
                  AND revision.contact_masked_jsonb = NEW.contact_masked_jsonb
                  AND revision.note = NEW.note
                  AND revision.approval_mode = NEW.approval_mode
           ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.work_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.work_order_id
       OR NEW.purpose IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.purpose
       OR NEW.urgency IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.urgency
       OR NEW.expected_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.expected_date
       OR NEW.address_snapshot_jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.address_snapshot_jsonb
       OR NEW.address_masked_jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.address_masked_jsonb
       OR NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contact_snapshot_jsonb
       OR NEW.contact_masked_jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contact_masked_jsonb
       OR NEW.note IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.note THEN
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
              FROM public.material_request_revisions AS revision
             WHERE revision.request_id = NEW.id
               AND revision.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
               AND revision.status = 'draft'
               AND revision.work_order_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.work_order_id
               AND revision.purpose = NEW.purpose
               AND revision.urgency = NEW.urgency
               AND revision.expected_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.expected_date
               AND revision.address_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.address_snapshot_jsonb
               AND revision.address_masked_jsonb = NEW.address_masked_jsonb
               AND revision.contact_snapshot_jsonb = NEW.contact_snapshot_jsonb
               AND revision.contact_masked_jsonb = NEW.contact_masked_jsonb
               AND revision.note = NEW.note
               AND revision.approval_mode = NEW.approval_mode
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF OLD.status IN ('draft', 'returned')
       AND NEW.status IN ('submitted', 'approval_in_progress')
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_revisions AS revision
            WHERE revision.request_id = NEW.id
              AND revision.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
              AND revision.status = 'sealed'
       ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.outbound_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.outbound_status THEN
        IF OLD.outbound_status NOT IN ('not_started', 'pending_pick', 'picked')
           OR NEW.outbound_status NOT IN ('pending_pick', 'picked', 'outbound')
           OR NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NEW.allocation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.allocation_status
           OR NEW.reservation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_status
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_commands c
                WHERE c.request_id = NEW.id AND c.target_version = NEW.version AND c.operation IN ('pick', 'outbound')
                  AND c.result_jsonb->'state_axes'->>'outbound_status' = NEW.outbound_status)
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated'; END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.personal_inbound_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.personal_inbound_status THEN
        IF NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NEW.personal_inbound_status IS DISTINCT FROM (WITH line_totals AS (
        SELECT line.id, line.final_approved_qty - line.cancelled_qty AS net,
            COALESCE((SELECT sum(receipt_line.accepted_qty)
                FROM public.receipt_lines receipt_line
                JOIN public.receipts receipt ON receipt.id = receipt_line.receipt_id
                JOIN public.shipment_lines shipped ON shipped.id = receipt_line.shipment_line_id
                JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = shipped.outbound_posting_id
                WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND outbound.request_line_id = line.id
                  AND receipt.status IN ('accepted', 'exception')), 0) AS accepted,
            COALESCE((SELECT sum(receipt_line.accepted_qty)
                FROM public.receipt_lines receipt_line
                JOIN public.receipts receipt ON receipt.id = receipt_line.receipt_id
                JOIN public.shipment_lines shipped ON shipped.id = receipt_line.shipment_line_id
                JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = shipped.outbound_posting_id
                WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND outbound.request_line_id = line.id
                  AND receipt.status IN ('accepted', 'exception') AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM public.inbound_orders inbound
                    JOIN public.inbound_postings posting ON posting.inbound_order_id = inbound.id
                    JOIN public.inventory_transactions tx ON tx.id = posting.inventory_transaction_id
                    WHERE inbound.receipt_id = receipt_line.receipt_id
                      AND tx.status = 'posted' AND tx.movement_type = 'transfer'
                      AND tx.source_document_type = 'personal_inbound'
                      AND replace(CAST(inbound.id AS text), '-', '') = replace(tx.source_document_id, '-', '')
                )), 0) AS posted,
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.shipment_lines shipped
                JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = shipped.outbound_posting_id
                WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND outbound.request_line_id = line.id
                  AND shipped.shipped_qty > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS shipped
        FROM public.material_request_lines line
        WHERE line.request_id = NEW.id AND line.revision_no = NEW.revision_no
          AND line.final_approved_qty > line.cancelled_qty
    ) SELECT CASE
        WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'not_started'
        WHEN sum(CASE WHEN posted >= net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = count(*) THEN 'posted'
        WHEN sum(CASE WHEN accepted >= net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = count(*) THEN 'accepted'
        WHEN sum(CASE WHEN accepted > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'partially_accepted'
        WHEN sum(shipped) > 0 THEN 'pending_acceptance'
        ELSE 'not_started' END FROM line_totals) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION '0084 personal inbound projection does not match fulfillment facts' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.shipment_status IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.shipments shipment
        JOIN public.material_request_commands command
          ON command.idempotency_key_hash = shipment.idempotency_key_hash
        JOIN public.shipment_lines line ON line.shipment_id = shipment.id
        JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = line.outbound_posting_id
        WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND line.shipped_qty > 0
          AND shipment.status = 'shipped' AND command.operation = 'shipment'
          AND command.request_id = NEW.id AND command.target_version <= NEW.version
          AND command.request_hash = shipment.request_hash
          AND command.occurred_at = shipment.created_at 
    ) THEN 'shipped' ELSE 'not_started' END)
       OR (NEW.shipment_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.shipment_status AND (
           NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.shipments shipment
        JOIN public.material_request_commands command
          ON command.idempotency_key_hash = shipment.idempotency_key_hash
        JOIN public.shipment_lines line ON line.shipment_id = shipment.id
        JOIN public.outbound_postings outbound ON outbound.id = line.outbound_posting_id
        WHERE outbound.request_id = NEW.id AND line.shipped_qty > 0
          AND shipment.status = 'shipped' AND command.operation = 'shipment'
          AND command.request_id = NEW.id AND command.target_version = NEW.version
          AND command.request_hash = shipment.request_hash
          AND command.occurred_at = shipment.created_at AND command.occurred_at = NEW.updated_at
    ))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '0168 shipment projection does not match handover command' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.logistics_signature_status <> 'not_signed'
       OR NEW.oam_receipt_status <> 'not_occurred'
       OR NEW.notification_status <> 'not_started'
       OR NEW.reconciliation_status <> 'not_started' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.allocation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.allocation_status
       AND NEW.reservation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_status THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.allocation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.allocation_status THEN
        IF OLD.allocation_status NOT IN ('not_allocated', 'partially_allocated')
           OR NEW.allocation_status NOT IN ('partially_allocated', 'allocated')
           OR NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1
           OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM public.stock_allocations AS allocation
                 JOIN public.material_request_commands AS command
                   ON command.request_id = allocation.request_id
                  AND command.operation = 'allocate'
                  AND command.target_version = NEW.version
                WHERE allocation.request_id = NEW.id
                  AND allocation.request_version = NEW.version
                  AND allocation.status = 'allocated'
                  AND command.request_jsonb->>'request_id' = NEW.id::text
                  AND command.request_jsonb->>'target_version' = NEW.version::text
           ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.reservation_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_status THEN
        IF OLD.reservation_status NOT IN ('not_reserved', 'pending', 'reserved', 'partially_released', 'released')
           OR NEW.reservation_status NOT IN ('pending', 'reserved', 'partially_released', 'released')
           OR NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
           OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM public.material_request_commands c
                WHERE c.request_id = NEW.id AND c.target_version = NEW.version
                  AND c.operation IN ('reserve', 'release')
                  AND c.result_jsonb->'state_axes'->>'reservation_status' = NEW.reservation_status
           ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'formal material-request invariant violated'; END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
